title: He initialization, debugged
statement_md:
The snippet should return the **He initialization** standard deviation `sqrt(2 / fan_in)`, but it returns the Xavier value and crashes on invalid input.

- return `sqrt(2 / fan_in)` for `fan_in >= 1`
- raise `ValueError` when `fan_in < 1`

Fix the function; do not change its name or signature.
mutations: return math.sqrt(1.0 / fan_in) if fan_in >= 1 else float('nan')
